alerts.headline: ChatGPT新增Google Drive @mention跨工具拉取与macOS Computer History被动行为记忆，两项均触碰meee2差异化锚点
alerts.evidence: 「A file can be pulled into any chat from the composer or with an @mention, without uploading it again」「Clicks, keystrokes, keyboard shortcuts, and app switches are captured through macOS's accessibility system」
alerts.action_suggestion: Computer History是OpenAI首次把'被动观察真实行为'产品化为AI上下文来源，与meee2 descriptive canvas理念(flow从真实行为emerge)结构接近；Google Drive @mention则是跨工具artifact引用的初步尝试。建议评估：(1)meee2的descriptive-first能力是否已有比Computer History更强的差异化叙事(如live link而非事后总结)；(2)持续观察Computer History是否扩展到Windows/开放API，以及Drive集成是否演进为真正的live link而非索引式引用。
